title: 第13章 玉女心经第14章 逆练心经走火入魔
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
卧槽，这书名不对啊，《玉女心经》，名字好熟悉。
好像是前世一个电影的名字，难道世上真有这个内功心法？
还是看看里面的内容吧，翻开封皮，看到总纲的介绍，黄夜的脑袋顿时大了一圈。
功法倒是很正统，总共十二层，每三层一个境界，修炼到极致，可以达到武帝巅峰。
最后还有个备注，功法尚在开发中，读者可自行开发后续功法。
功法不全他可以接受，接受不了的是这是一本女子修炼功法，他一个老爷们怎么学。
翻到中间的页面，里面出现的人体图形都是女子身体，画风很辣眼睛。
此情此景，他想起了另一本武学秘籍——《葵花宝典》。
好歹《葵花宝典》是男人修炼的功法，不过白送他，也不会练那无鸟神功！
现在这本《玉女心经》，真没法修炼，黄夜不由得眉头紧皱。
“少爷，有什么不对么？”
“晴儿，他们就给你这一本功法么？”
“嗯，这本是徐大哥给我的，他说这本功法适合我修炼。”
“确实适合你修炼，这是女子修炼的功法，不适合男子修炼。”
“啊！那您不是修炼不了，怪不得徐大哥是从箱子底下翻出来的。”
晴儿想起徐侍卫为了给她找这本功法，直接把箱子翻个底朝天。
她还以为功法很珍贵，所以藏那么深。
捧着书便兴高采烈跑回来，没想到这是人家不用的功法。
“少爷，要不我再去要男子修炼的功法？”
“不行，你现在去要男子的功法，他们肯定有所怀疑。”

“这件事儿先不急，过段时间再借，到时候你就说想借鉴一下。”
“我先研究一下这套功法，男女体内构造不同，不过穴位基本一样。”
“公子这个也知道？”晴儿好奇的问道。
“嗯！知道一些。”黄夜心虚的应道。
同时心道，我不知道没关系，我这系统可是百科大全，生理卫生肯定好。
通读了一遍《玉女心经》，大致看了里面内容。
合上典籍，陷入沉思中。
看来真不能修炼这个功法，里面特别强化的是女子阴柔之气。
长时间修炼的后果就是阴气占主导地位，不断地减弱他的阳刚之气。
如果真的修炼，自己很可能变成G、A、Y。
自己的取向肯定会变，跟修炼《葵花宝典》没什么区别。
“晴儿，我大概看了一下，这部功法适合你练习，我没法修炼。”
“少爷别灰心，过几天我就去找徐大哥他们，肯定能找到适合你的功法。”
“也只能如此。”
“对了，在外面能买到功法么？”
“我也不清楚，明天我去书肆看看有没有卖功法的。”
“书肆？是卖书的地方么？”
“嗯，城里有几家书肆，里面有各种书籍售卖。”
“如果是那种地方就不用去了，那里即使有武学典籍，也是垃圾货，不如不看。”
“我先学这套拳法，功法的事儿不急。”

说罢，便拿起拳法典籍翻阅起来，拳法名字很普通——《无极拳》。
content_en:
Damn it, the title of this book is wrong, "The Jade Girl's Heart Sutra", the name is so familiar.
It seems to be the title of a movie in a previous life. Is this inner strength and mental method really possible in the world?
Let's take a look at the content inside. Opening the cover and seeing the introduction of the general outline, Huang Ye's head suddenly grew bigger.
The technique is very orthodox, with a total of twelve levels, and every three levels is a realm. If you practice to the extreme, you can reach the peak of the Martial Emperor.
Finally, there is a note: the exercises are still under development, and readers can develop subsequent exercises on their own.
He could accept that the exercises were incomplete, but what he couldn't accept was that this was a women's cultivation method, how could he, a man, learn it.
Turn to the middle page, and the human figures that appear inside are all female bodies, and the style of painting is very eye-catching.
In this situation, he remembered another martial arts secret book - "The Sunflower Book".
After all, the "Sunflower Collection" is a technique for men to practice, but if you give it to him for free, he won't be able to practice the magic weapon without a bird!
Now this "Jade Girl Heart Sutra" is really impossible to practice, Huang Ye can't help but frown.
"Master, is something wrong?"
"Qing'er, will they just give you this skill?"
"Well, this book was given to me by Brother Xu. He said that this book is suitable for my practice."
"It is indeed suitable for you to practice. This is a technique for women to practice, not suitable for men to practice."
"Ah! Then it's not like you can't practice. No wonder Brother Xu dug it out from under the box."
Qing'er remembered that Guard Xu had turned the box upside down in order to find this book for her.
She thought the skills were very precious, so she hid them so deeply.
He ran back happily with the book in his hands, but he didn't expect that this was a technique that others didn't use.
"Master, how about I ask for the men's cultivation techniques again?"
"No, if you ask for a man's technique now, they will definitely be suspicious."
"Don't rush this matter now. We can borrow it after a while. Then you can just say that you want to learn from it."
"I'll study this set of exercises first. The body structures of men and women are different, but the acupuncture points are basically the same."
"Young master, do you know this too?" Qing'er asked curiously.
"Yeah! I know something." Huang Ye replied with a guilty conscience.
At the same time, he thought to himself, "I don't know, it doesn't matter. My system is an encyclopedia, and my physical hygiene must be good."
I read through the "Jade Girl's Heart Sutra" and roughly looked at its contents.
He closed the book and fell into deep thought.
It seems that you really cannot practice this technique. What is particularly strengthened in it is the feminine energy of women.
The result of long-term practice is that the Yin energy dominates, constantly weakening his masculine energy.
If you really practice, you will probably become G, A, or Y.
Your own orientation will definitely change, it is no different from practicing the "Sunflower Book".
"Qing'er, I took a quick look and found that this technique is suitable for you to practice, but I can't practice it."
"Don't be discouraged, young master. I will go find Brother Xu and the others in a few days. I will definitely be able to find a technique that suits you."
"That's all it can do."
"By the way, can I buy the exercises outside?"
"I don't know either. I'll go to the book store tomorrow to see if there are any that sell exercises."
"Bookstore? Is it a place that sells books?"
"Well, there are several bookstores in the city that sell all kinds of books."
"If it's that kind of place, there's no need to go there. Even if there are martial arts books there, they're just rubbish. It's better not to read them."
"I'll learn this boxing technique first. There's no rush about the technique."
After saying that, he picked up the boxing book and started reading it. The name of the boxing method was very ordinary - "Wuji Fist".
